dedicated.name: Heavenia's Wings of Frost

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Heavenia by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"Haah... I'm going to protect my older sister!"

At an abandoned mansion deep within some nameless swamp in the Celestial Realm, Heavenia finds herself on the verge of having her fate stolen by a twisted mage. But with her older sister Hellenia's help, she overcomes the harrowing ordeal of nearly losing her fate and manages to carve out a new future. Six wings embodying Heavenia's steadfast will suddenly sprout from her back. Forged from unbreakable, eternal frost, her wings hold her heartfelt wish to become even stronger and be her sister's protector from now on.

lore:
Despite being frail in her youth, Heavenia was able to regain her health thanks to a secret pact her sister Hellenia made with Skuld. Afterward, Heavenia joined Hellenia to investigate a string of Valkyrie disappearances and defeat a mage of the Ulfheddin at an abandoned mansion in a swamp. She then graduated at the top of her class from the military academy and went on to become a Valkyrie.

Heavenia's desire to increase her strength continued to intensify, and several years later, while carrying out missions as part of the Evan Expedition, she was lured back to the old abandoned mansion from her past by a mysterious doll.

Deep within the mansion's basement, she realized too late that the doll was the daughter of the Ulfheddin mage she had defeated all those years ago and discovered the girl's true objective. However, she failed to subdue the mage and found herself on the verge of having her very destiny stolen away.

Just as the thread of Heavenia's destiny was about to be torn from its spool, the fates of the two sisters dramatically intertwined, forging a path towards a whole new destiny.
